about.Method: Each year is scored independently (models retrained per year for meta
about.Schedule normalization: Point totals rescaled per year by REF/N_ref (REF=17.3 matches) so schedule length doesn't bias the
about.CareerVal: CareerLPS / D  (bulk; D = typical career length = 7.5)
about.PaceVal: per-active-year LPS, empirical-Bayes shrunk toward the cohort mean (prior = 25 weighted games) -- rate reward, length-neutral
about.PeakVal: best plateau of the top-k seasons: max over k of mean(top k) + 0.15*(k-th best season)*(k-1); PeakYrs = that k. A better season never lowers it.
about.+ Resume: w_bonus * (Intl + Titles + Awards) -- see Resume bonuses below
about.Intl: Worlds/MSI placement points (champion..play-in), flat by event+round.
about.Titles: Domestic split-playoff titles/finals, each scaled by that region's Elo
about.Awards: Regional MVP / All-Pro / Finals MVP (auto-pulled from Leaguepedia to
about.repeat_decay: 0.8  -- winning the SAME kind of thing (Worlds/MSI at a given round; domestic champ/finalist; a given award) repeatedly is
